name: CloddsBot
description: Open Source AI trading agent that operates autonomously across 1000+ markets - Polymarket, Kalshi, Binance, Hyperliquid, Solana DEXs, 5 EVM chains. Scans for edge, executes instantly, manages risk while you sleep. Agent commerce protocol for machine-to-machine payments. Self-hosted. Built on Claude.
one_liner: A self-hosted robot trader that watches prediction markets and crypto exchanges around the clock and places bets or trades for you using an AI model.
buyer: A crypto-savvy retail trader who already trades prediction markets manually and wants an automated system watching dozens of markets they can't monitor themselves.
business_use_cases: An independent trader runs it on a home server to auto-trade small BTC/ETH prediction markets while at their day job.
A crypto influencer offers a paid Discord where they share tuned strategy configs for the bot to subscribers.
A small prop-trading group forks it to add proprietary strategies and runs it as an internal tool across a pooled account.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a curated set of 'strategy configs' or subscription access to a hosted, managed instance for non-technical traders.
Offer paid setup/'secure your server' consulting for less technical users, since self-hosting with real money at stake is risky.

steal_this: Take just the Polymarket module, add a dead-simple onboarding wizard, and sell it as a $19/mo 'auto-trade Polymarket for me' product this weekend.
